evidence_requirements.required_evidence: Owner-approved target audience, consent, and data-handling plan.
Exact test tasks, questions, scoring rubric, and stop criteria.
No sensitive data exposure, no unlicensed assets, and no unclear rights.
Every public-facing claim mapped to evidence and approval status.
Clear stop condition if feedback reveals safety, quality, or reputation risk.
